searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json (29 companies), sent-log.json (last ~40 opportunity titles, to avoid repeats), applications.json (empty), and life/PIPELINE.md (in-flight/closed, excluded from consideration: IBM x6, Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, 3x Adobe reqs, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM). Also confirmed the graduation-date conflict flagged in this run's brief no longer exists -- life/PROFILE.md shows it was resolved to December 2026 on 2026-08-04, matching morning-briefing/profile.md; no live conflict to reconcile. WebSearch worked and surfaced candidate leads (e.g. a Databricks 'Associate Product Manager, New Grad (2027 Start)' req, graduation Fall 2026/Spring 2027 eligible per search snippets). WebFetch was completely non-functional this run: every fetch attempt returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, tested against boards-api.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, www.databricks.com, www.anthropic.com, and www.google.com as a control -- a total environment-level egress block on all outbound fetches, not a per-site policy (confirmed via the proxy status endpoint: recentRelayFailures empty, meaning the block happens before the destination is even attempted). This is the same failure mode reported on 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-09 -- three consecutive days. hunt.md's verification rule requires confirming from the actual page that applications are open and the user is eligible; a search snippet or aggregator listing is explicitly disallowed as sole evidence. With no working fetch, no candidate (including the promising Databricks APM lead) could be verified, so nothing is included. Zero verified opportunities is the honest and correct output, not a sign nothing was findable -- the Databricks APM req is worth a manual look.
